name: NexJu AI – Website Assistant
author: nexjuai

sections.description:
NexJu AI is an assistant for the websites of small businesses: it answers your visitors’ questions from what is on your website and takes requests for you.

What the assistant does for your visitors:

  • It answers questions about your services, prices and opening hours from the content of your website.
  • It takes requests and callback wishes and sends them to you by email.
  • It says openly that it is an AI assistant.
  • It answers in German and English, in the larger plans in your visitor’s language.
  • Your website only loads a small script of about 5 KB; the chat itself loads when a visitor opens it.

This plugin saves you from adding code to your theme. You copy the line of code from your NexJu AI account into a field under “Settings” and save. That is all.

What the plugin does:

  • It loads the assistant’s script in the footer of every page.
  • It only accepts the line of code in exactly its form. It does not store any other code.
  • It creates a single setting and removes it again when you delete the plugin.

What you need: an account at NexJu AI (nexjuai.com) with an assistant set up for the domain of this website. The free plan includes 30 conversations per month, without a payment method and without a minimum term. Paid plans start at €29 net per month. Accounts are only available to businesses based in Germany.

The plugin’s interface is available in English and German.

External services

The plugin embeds a script from app.nexjuai.com. This service is operated by JuNa Web UG (haftungsbeschränkt). When any page loads, the script and the assistant’s settings are fetched from there; like any web server, the service learns the visitor’s IP address and the address of the website. If a visitor writes in the assistant, their messages as well as the path and title of the page currently open are transmitted there and answered there. The assistant sets no cookies and stores nothing in the browser.

The plugin itself sends nothing anywhere until an administrator has saved the line of code.

  • Terms of service (German): https://app.nexjuai.com/recht/agb
  • Privacy policy of the service (German): https://app.nexjuai.com/recht/datenschutz
  • What data the assistant processes, in English: https://nexjuai.com/data
  • Privacy policy of the website nexjuai.com, in English: https://nexjuai.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In the WordPress dashboard choose “Plugins” → “Add Plugin”, search for “NexJu AI” and click “Install Now”. (Or choose “Upload Plugin” and select the ZIP file from your account.)
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open “Settings” → “NexJu AI”.
  4. Paste the line of code from your account and save.
  5. If you use a caching plugin, clear the cache once.
sections.faq:
What does it cost?

The free plan costs nothing: 30 conversations per month, without a payment method and without a minimum term, once per business; the chat window shows “with NexJu AI”. When the conversations are used up, new visitors get a short request form until the end of the month, and nothing is charged. For more conversations there are three plans: Start €29, Plus €59 or Profi €99 net per month plus 19 % VAT, cancellable monthly; on the annual plan €24, €49 or €82 per month with a 12-month minimum term. Included are 100, 250 or 600 conversations per month. The plugin itself is free. All prices: https://nexjuai.com/pricing

How do I start?

Open “Settings” → “NexJu AI” and click “Start for free”, or go to https://app.nexjuai.com/einrichten?p=gratis. You enter your website, check what the assistant has learned from it and copy the line of code into this plugin.

Where do I find my line of code?

In your NexJu AI account under “Code & installation”.

The assistant does not appear.

It only runs on the domain you set it up for. Also clear your website’s cache. In your account you can have it checked whether the line has arrived on your website.

Does the assistant set cookies?

No.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, with any theme that outputs the standard WordPress footer. The plugin loads the script through WordPress itself.

Does it slow down my website?

Hardly: your pages load a script of about 5 KB. The chat itself only loads when a visitor opens it.

Which languages does the assistant speak?

German and English. In the larger plans it answers in your visitor’s language.
sections.changelog:
1.2.7

  • Settings page: without a line of code it shows the free plan and the prices, with a button to start for free.
  • Description: the free plan, the prices and two more questions and answers.

1.2.6

  • Description: what the assistant does, three more questions and answers. No change to the code.

1.2.5

  • Security hardening: the script tag is extended instead of replaced (attributes set by WordPress or other plugins stay), translations cannot break the settings page, an older saved address is rewritten once, and uninstalling in large networks runs in batches.

1.2.4

  • Description: NexJu AI is only available to businesses based in Germany. No change to the code.

1.2.3

  • The script is always loaded from app.nexjuai.com; lines of code with the older address keep working.
  • A damaged setting in the database no longer stops the site.

1.2.2

  • Only the address of the service’s own script is accepted in the line of code.
  • On a network (multisite), deleting the plugin removes the setting on every site.

1.2.1

  • German translations follow the WordPress glossary and use the informal or the formal form, as WordPress itself does.

1.2.0

  • The colours of the settings page are loaded as a stylesheet file.
  • Links to the terms and the privacy policy of the service in this readme.

1.1.0

  • Interface in English and German.
  • Settings page in the colours of NexJu AI.

1.0.0

  • First version.
